{"type":"tool_use","timestamp":"2026-11-15T10:35:55.546Z","tool_name":"replace","tool_id":"replace__call_11422308446375143392","parameters":{"old_string":"## [Unreleased]\n\n## [0.3.0] - 2026-09-17","new_string":"## [Unreleased]\n\n### Changed\n\n- **Migration: `ToolRegistry.execute` now validates tool input against `inputSchema` before calling the executor.**\n  A static tool's JSON Schema is compiled at `register` time (throwing synchronously if the schema itself is\n  invalid), and a function-valued tool definition's schema is compiled and cached by schema object reference on\n  each call. When `input` violates `required`, declared property types or `enum`, `execute` logs the failing\n  property paths without logging values and returns a `ToolResponse` describing the violation so the model can\n  correct the call on the next tool round instead of ending the turn with an unhandled error; undeclared extra\n  properties still pass through unchanged without type coercion or injected defaults. An executor that previously\n  hand-validated its arguments now receives only input the declared schema already accepts, so any tool that\n  relied on seeing malformed input to return its own custom error message will no longer be called for those\n  inputs.\n\n## [0.3.0] - 2026-09-17","file_path":"/var/tmp/loop-bench/runs/350dbe131547/workspace/target/CHANGELOG.md","instruction":"Add a Keep a Changelog ### Changed migration entry under ## [Unreleased] in CHANGELOG.md documenting ToolRegistry.execute inputSchema validation so scripts/check-changelog.sh passes and npm consumers see the migration note."}}
